races.verdict: Preference is for SON OF HYPNOS , who bolted up under an attacking ride at Newton Abbot in August and Ryan Chapman's 9-y-o did a bit too much too soon attempting to replicate those tactics back there last month. SON OF HYPNOS (IRE) DONNIE AZOFF (IRE) KRAK (FR)

races.display_title: Cavani Champion Style Handicap
races.verdict: A tight-knit handicap in which marginal preference is for C&D scorer NEPTUNE LEGEND who has slipped in the weights and now has the services of Billy Loughnane. Far Too Fizzy could emerge as the chief threat with Oisin Murphy also an eye-catching booking, while On Key and Koffee And Kale can also have a say. NEPTUNE LEGEND (IRE) FAR TOO FIZZY ON KEY

races.verdict: The return to around 3m should suit SAMUI who may prove the answer to this trappy contest. Sandor Clegane isn't the easiest to win with but is still classy and has a decent record fresh so he might be the one to give Gordon Elliott's charge most to do. SAMUI SANDOR CLEGANE (IRE) BUDDY ONE (IRE)

races.verdict: LIVE TO LAUGH 's reappearance third at Listowel suggests he should have a race in him from his lower hurdle mark, particularly as the form has been franked by the fourth winning since. Warmer Days Ahead has had the form of his latest Kilbeggan success boosted on a few occasions and is second choice. Milan Forth and Labondance complete the shortlist. races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict: JUNCTION ROAD has been the subject of a notable stable switch since her promising debut at Down Royal 7 weeks ago and she could make a winning start for Henry de Bromhead if building on that. Shuil Solas and Back In Favour are a couple of others who seem sure to be in the mix. Eastern Whisper is the most interesting newcomer. JUNCTION ROAD (IRE) SHUIL SOLAS (IRE) BACK IN FAVOUR (IRE)
